user_query: I'm organizing a surprise birthday party for my best friend. To invite our friends, I want to create a WhatsApp group and share the QR code with them.

TaskList.description: Generate a QR code image for a specific phone ID '54321' using the getQRCode API.
Retrieve birthday-related messages from the 'Birthday' category using the getMsgs API.
Create a WhatsApp group with the invited friends and share the generated QR code and birthday messages.
